content: CLI commands should resolve project paths through VcsBackendFactory.create({ backend: "auto" }, process.cwd()) and backend getRepoRoot()/getMainRepoRoot() rather than direct lib/git.ts helpers in colocated jj repos.

name: pi-sdk-claude-oauth
description: Pi SDK (@mariozechner/pi-ai v0.73) supports Claude Pro/Max OAuth: sk-ant-oat tokens auto-detected → Bearer authToken + claude-code identity headers (anthropic-beta: claude-code-20250219,oauth-2025-04-20). AuthStorage.getApiKey priority: runtime override > api_key in ~/.pi/agent/auth.json > oauth in auth.json (auto-refreshed) > env (ANTHROPIC_OAUTH_TOKEN > ANTHROPIC_API_KEY). Foreman's pi-sdk-runner reads ~/.pi/agent/auth.json. OAuth tokens expire and need refresh; API keys don't.
